about: LOD 400 Kampala aluminium window: 50x100 frame, casement (1 or 2 leaves, mullion by Leaf Count) or 2-track sliding leaves that overlap at the centre with interlock stiles, and a top-hung projected (PJ) vent over the transom. Height runs from the template Sill plane (z = 0) to Head; leaf top = Height - Fanlight Height. Casement vs sliding parts and the mesh are switched by Yes/No-driven offset formulas that collapse the part into the left jamb (Hide Offset / Hide Width). The recipe puts its outer face at -y, but the template's plane named Exterior is at +y (field review, 15 Oct): the Revit retest confirms which way the family faces in a wall; frame centred on the wall. The vent's opening triangle is a symbolic line drawn for the default type and does not flex. Profile slot (gen_profile_slots.py): FMC_Design_Movement (1-20, default 17) shows one of 20 Surround sweeps (Ext face) from FMC_Profile_Surround_<Token>, each bound to Show_<Token>. Sweep paths are drawn at the first type's size (1200x1500) and don't flex with Width/Height until sweep paths can be locked to planes.

ops.name: 1200x1500_Casement-TopHung300/FMC_Frame_Spec
ops.value: Aluminium window, frame 50x100 (series to confirm), 5 mm clear glass; casement or 2-track sliding leaves; top-hung projected (PJ) vent over; precast sill

ops.name: Mullion Offset
ops.formula: if(and(not(Leaves Sliding), Leaf Count > 1), Frame Width + (Width - 2 * Frame Width - Mullion Width) / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Casement Glass L Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaves Sliding, Hide Offset, Frame Width)

ops.name: Casement Glass R Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaves Sliding, Hide Offset + Hide Width, Width - Frame Width)

ops.name: Slide Ext L Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaves Sliding, Frame Width, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Slide Ext R Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaves Sliding, Width / 2 + Sash Overlap / 2, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: Slide Int L Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaves Sliding, Width / 2 - Sash Overlap / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Slide Int R Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaves Sliding, Width - Frame Width, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: Interlock Ext Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaves Sliding, Width / 2 + Sash Overlap / 2 - Interlock Width, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Interlock Int Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaves Sliding, Width / 2 - Sash Overlap / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Mesh R Offset
ops.formula: if(FMC_Mosquito_Mesh, Width - Frame Width, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: FMC_Glazed_Area_m2
ops.formula: (Width - 2 * Frame Width) * (Height - Fanlight Height - Frame Width) + (Width - 2 * Frame Width) * (Fanlight Height - Transom Depth - Frame Width)

ops.name: FMC_Openable_Area_m2
ops.formula: (Width - 2 * Frame Width) * (Height - Fanlight Height - Frame Width) * if(Leaves Sliding, 0.5, 1) + (Width - 2 * Frame Width) * (Fanlight Height - Transom Depth - Frame Width)
